exam.title: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; the official exam guide recommends related training and six months of hands-on Databricks experience. Practice SQL, basic Python/PySpark, ETL, cloud storage, identity, Lakeflow Jobs, CI/CD and Unity Catalog governance.

review.notes: The May 4, 2026 detailed PDF and live seven-domain weighted page were reconciled. All objectives map to mechanism, selection, state, identity, evidence, failure and recovery decisions. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover platform/compute, five ingestion patterns, schema/replay, PySpark/SQL transformation, joins/modeling/quality/tuning, Lakeflow Jobs control flow/triggers, Git folders and Declarative Automation Bundles, run/Spark diagnosis, managed/external lifecycle and Unity Catalog privileges/fine-grained controls. All 28 guide URLs are cataloged: 27 reachable and the O'Reilly book automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Commercial duration and freshness limitations are explicit, and vendor sample questions are linked rather than reproduced.

findings.title: Exam DENY wording conflicts with SQL command scope
findings.evidence: PDF Domain 7 names DENY; SQL command is hive_metastore-only. Separate ABAC DENY beta supports MANAGE_ACCESS_CONTROL, not generic denial of data reads.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Schema evolution explanation omitted restart
findings.evidence: Add-new-columns updates schema state and stops before a restart uses it.
findings.recommendation: Explain recovery and distinct discovery/trigger/checkpoint roles.
findings.resolution: Explain recovery and distinct discovery/trigger/checkpoint roles.

findings.title: Batch winner and casting example was underspecified
findings.evidence: Timestamp-only ordering can tie, and invalid casts can fail under ANSI behavior.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit sequence tie-breaker, latest-first validation and visible quarantine; label batch scope.
findings.resolution: Use explicit sequence tie-breaker, latest-first validation and visible quarantine; label batch scope.

findings.title: Lifecycle conversion objective lacked concrete teaching
findings.evidence: SET MANAGED syntax depends on external versus foreign source; UNSET MANAGED is a bounded rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add prerequisite, syntax and rollback decision guidance.
findings.resolution: Add prerequisite, syntax and rollback decision guidance.

findings.title: Cleanup condition needed exclusion semantics
findings.evidence: All excluded parents exclude a downstream task regardless of run-if.
findings.recommendation: Explain why All done is not an unconditional finally block.
findings.resolution: Explain why All done is not an unconditional finally block.
